title: Replace Query with Parameter

solutions.title: A reserve count every caller states, not sets
solutions.tradeoff: Every one of the three callers now has to know the reserve count it wants and say so, instead of leaving `sectionHasAvailability` to look it up - and a fourth caller with no opinion on the reserve has to invent one, where before it could call the function and get the box office's current answer for free.

reviewFocus: Does `sectionHasAvailability` still read `reservedSeatCount` from module scope in any branch, or does every path to that number now come in as a parameter?
Is `setReservedSeatCount` gone from `availability.ts`, or does it still exist as dead code nobody calls?
Does `sectionAvailabilitySummary` compute both answers without mutating any shared state between the two calls, or does it still set-call-set-call the way the challenge does?

Does the walkthrough name the case where reaching into shared state is the right call - and say what makes this module's staff/public split different from that case - rather than treating a parameter as strictly better than a global?

Cross-reference drill-11-05: does this walkthrough's argument for pushing the reserve count out to every caller actually contradict 11-05's argument for pulling a query inside, or are they the same question about dependency ownership answered oppositely for a good reason?
